🌀 Typhoon Kalmaegi (“Tino”) intensifies over the Philippine Sea 🇵🇭
Now packing winds of 150–165 km/h, it’s set to make landfall tonight (≈23:00 PHT) across the central Philippines.

⚠️ Hazards: torrential rain (up to 400 mm), destructive winds, storm surge & waves up to 9 m.
Flooding and landslides likely.

Kalmaegi will re-intensify over the South China Sea midweek before reaching Vietnam later this week.

Heavy Rainfall Warning No. 1 #NCR_PRSD
Weather System: Shear Line
Issued at: 6:25 PM, 03 November 2025(Monday)

YELLOW WARNING LEVEL: Quezon, Laguna and Batangas.
ASSOCIATED HAZARD: Possible FLOODING in flood-prone areas.
Meanwhile, expect light to moderate with occasional heavy rains over Pampanga, Bataan, Tarlac and Zambales within the next 3 hours.
Light to moderate with occasional heavy rains affecting Rizal, Metro Manila, Cavite, Bulacan and Nueva Ecija(General Tinio, Gabaldon) which may persist within 3 hours and may affect nearby areas.

The public and the Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Offices concerned are advised to MONITOR the weather condition and watch for the next warning to be issued at 8:00 PM today.
